description.value: The Sid Williams Theatre is a 500-seat performing arts centre in downtown Courtenay, BC, operated by the Sid Williams Theatre Society as a registered charitable organization. Originally opened in 1935 as the Bickle Theatre, it has evolved into the Comox Valley's primary live performance venue, hosting everything from Indigenous dance companies and stand-up comedy to tribute acts and professional touring productions. It is a significant cultural landmark on Vancouver Island's cycling routes and a natural stop for touring cyclists spending time in Courtenay.
